name: Acute Care Specialist
description: Emergency department + acute / critical-care decision support. Marketplace-publishable A2A specialist sharing the TrustedRisk MCP backend. Advertises 11 skills: ED admission triage (ESI + disposition), Inpatient deterioration score (NEWS2), Acute stroke severity + reperfusion eligibility, HEART score + ACS disposition, Polytrauma severity + massive transfusion, DKA severity + inpatient glycemic control, ACR appropriateness + contrast safety, KDIGO AKI staging + dialysis initiation, MEOWS + ACOG preeclampsia assessment, Morse falls + CAM delirium screening, PHI leakage check. FHIR context propagated via the A2A v1 FHIR-context extension; tools see the FHIRContext via the shared ContextVar without ever surfacing the bearer token to the LLM prompt. Every recommendation surfaces a calibrated CI when applicable, a deterministic safety gate, an abstain trigger when uncertainty or demographic bias is high, a 4-critic ensemble vote (clinical_safety + fairness + evidence + llm_judge) with bounded plan revision, a fairness audit by demographic subgroup, and a longitudinal patient timeline that surfaces drift across encounters.

_bundles._doc: Thematic groupings for client-side discovery. Tools may appear in multiple bundles (e.g. ground_claim, fairness_audit). The runtime exposes BUNDLES via the tools package (mcp_server.tools.list_bundles()).

skills.name: ED admission triage (ESI + disposition)
skills.description: Apply the AHRQ Emergency Severity Index v4 + Manchester Triage red-flag rules to a chief complaint + vital signs + age. Produces ESI level 1-5, priority (immediate / emergent / urgent / less_urgent / non_urgent), disposition (resuscitation_room / admit_inpatient / admit_observation / ED_workup_then_dispose / discharge_from_ED), and recommended unit. The tool is conservative: any chief-complaint red flag (chest pain, focal neuro deficit, thunderclap headache, GI bleed, sepsis pattern, suicidal intent) plus any abnormal vital signs pull the ESI floor downward. Without vitals on a high-acuity complaint the tool sets abstain_recommended=true.
examples: Triage a 58-year-old with crushing chest pain radiating to left arm, BP 95/62, HR 115.
ESI assessment for a pediatric patient: 3-month-old infant lethargic, not feeding.

skills.name: Inpatient deterioration score (NEWS2)
skills.description: Compute the Royal College of Physicians NEWS2 early-warning score on a vital-sign set, with a trend delta vs prior-shift score that surfaces deterioration earlier than point-in-time NEWS2 alone. Returns total score 0-20, severity tier (low / low_medium / medium / high), and recommended response (routine_12h_obs / increase_obs_4_6h / urgent_review_1h / emergency_response). A single 3-point parameter escalates the response tier even at moderate totals. Used for rapid-response triage on the ward and for ICU step-up decisions.
examples: Score this patient's vitals: HR 122, SpO2 91% on 2L, RR 26, BP 96/58, T 38.4, AVPU=V.
Compare this NEWS2 with the prior shift score of 3 to surface trend deterioration.

skills.name: Acute stroke severity + reperfusion eligibility
skills.description: Two stroke tools: (1) compute_stroke_severity scores the 15-item NIH Stroke Scale (0-42) with severity tiers (minor / moderate / moderate-severe / severe), an LVO indicator (NIHSS ≥6 with cortical signs — gaze, language, neglect, visual fields → suspect anterior-circulation large-vessel occlusion), and a recommended response that gates reperfusion vs supportive care by time-since-last-known-well; (2) compute_stroke_thrombolysis_eligibility encodes the AHA/ASA 2019 IV alteplase inclusion + extensive exclusion criteria (0-3h standard window, 3-4.5h extended window with extra exclusions) AND endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) eligibility (0-6h with confirmed LVO + ASPECTS ≥6, 6-24h via DAWN/DEFUSE 3 imaging mismatch). Decision tree resolves to iv_tpa_only / evt_only / iv_tpa_plus_evt / no_reperfusion_supportive_care / abstain_clinician_decision.
examples: Score NIHSS for a patient with R arm 3/5, gaze deviation, expressive aphasia.
Decide IV tPA + EVT eligibility for an LVO patient at 90 minutes from LKW.
Late-window EVT for stroke at 12h with imaging mismatch.

skills.name: HEART score + ACS disposition
skills.description: Two cardiology tools: (1) compute_heart_score computes the 5-item HEART score (History / ECG / Age / Risk-factors / Troponin), 0-10, with risk bands (0-3 low ~1.7% 30-day MACE; 4-6 moderate ~16.6%; 7-10 high ~50.1%); (2) compute_acs_disposition_decision combines the HEART total + STEMI status + dynamic troponin + high-risk features (ongoing pain, hemodynamic instability, new heart failure) into a 4-tier disposition (discharge_with_outpatient_followup / ed_observation_serial_troponin / admit_telemetry_for_workup / cath_lab_activation_immediate).
examples: Compute HEART for a 58yo with moderately suspicious chest pain, 2 RFs, normal trop.
Disposition for a HEART 5 patient with non-dynamic troponin.
STEMI on ECG → cath lab activation.

skills.name: Polytrauma severity + massive transfusion
skills.description: Three trauma-critical tools: (1) compute_trauma_severity_score (ISS Baker 1974 + T-RTS Champion 1989, AIS 1-6, 4 triage tiers); (2) compute_massive_transfusion_protocol (ABC score Nunez 2009 + 1:1:1 PROPPR ratio + TXA CRASH-2 ≤180 min window); (3) compute_imaging_appropriateness for blunt-trauma CT decisions. Surfaces ICU triage tier and transfusion activation gate.
examples: Score ISS+RTS for a 35y M with chest AIS 4, abdomen AIS 3.
Decide MTP activation on an ABC ≥2 patient at 25 min post-arrival.
Trauma-tier disposition for a polytrauma patient.

skills.name: DKA severity + inpatient glycemic control
skills.description: Two acute-endocrine tools: (1) compute_dka_severity (ADA/ISPAD severity tiers + IV fluid / insulin / K+ / HCO3 protocol gates); (2) compute_inpatient_glycemic_control (ADA 2024 basal-bolus titration + hypoglycemia risk score). Gates ICU admission on severe DKA classification.
examples: Classify DKA severity for a patient with pH 7.18, HCO3 9, glucose 480.
Titrate basal-bolus insulin for a 70 kg inpatient with A1c 9.1.

skills.name: ACR appropriateness + contrast safety
skills.description: Two imaging tools: (1) compute_imaging_appropriateness (ACR Appropriateness Criteria + Choosing Wisely + pediatric ALARA); (2) compute_contrast_safety_check (ACR 2024 + Davenport 2020 + metformin hold logic). Used in ED CT decisioning, peri-op imaging, and pre-contrast renal-safety gating.
examples: Decide CT vs MRI for blunt abdominal trauma 28y M.
Contrast safety check for eGFR 28 + metformin patient.

skills.name: KDIGO AKI staging + dialysis initiation
skills.description: Two renal tools: (1) compute_aki_kdigo_stage (KDIGO 2012 staging + etiology clue surface); (2) compute_dialysis_initiation_decision (AEIOU mnemonic + STARRT-AKI deferral + CRRT vs HD). Gates renal consult escalation and dose-adjusts upstream tools (e.g. contrast safety, vancomycin trough).
examples: Stage AKI for a patient with Cr rising 1.0 → 2.4 in 48 h.
Decide dialysis initiation timing on AEIOU criteria + STARRT-AKI evidence.

skills.name: MEOWS + ACOG preeclampsia assessment
skills.description: Two obstetric tools: (1) compute_maternal_early_warning implements the MEOWS color-coded (green/yellow/red) early-warning score with PREGNANCY-ADJUSTED vital thresholds (HR 80-110 normal in 3rd trimester, lower DBP, mildly elevated RR) — standard NEWS2 over-flags pregnant women; obstetric-specific red flags (severe headache, visual changes, chest pain, excess bleeding) escalate independently; (2) compute_preeclampsia_assessment implements the ACOG 2020 classification tree (gestational HTN / preeclampsia without severe / preeclampsia with severe / eclampsia / HELLP) with delivery recommendations gated by GA (≥37 for non-severe, ≥34 for severe), magnesium-sulfate + antihypertensive indications.
examples: MEOWS for a 32-week patient with BP 158/95 + severe headache.
Classify preeclampsia for a 34-week patient with BP 165/112 + thrombocytopenia.
Apply maternal-mortality fairness audit to a Black patient (3× elevated risk literature).

skills.name: Morse falls + CAM delirium screening
skills.description: Two geriatric tools: (1) compute_falls_risk_morse computes the 6-item Morse Falls Scale (0-125) with risk tiers (low <25, moderate 25-44, high ≥45) AND flags Beers-criteria falls-risk medications (benzodiazepines, opioids, sedating antihistamines, hypnotics, alpha-blockers, etc.); 3+ flagged meds bumps moderate to high tier; (2) compute_delirium_screening_cam implements the Confusion Assessment Method diagnostic algorithm (F1 acute onset/fluctuating + F2 inattention + (F3 disorganized thinking OR F4 altered consciousness)) with motor subtype (hyperactive / hypoactive / mixed), Beers deliriogenic-medication flagging, and DELIRIUM-mnemonic next-steps (workup, deprescribe, non-pharm bundle).
examples: Compute Morse for an 85yo on lorazepam + oxycodone + diphenhydramine.
Apply CAM to a fluctuating-confusion patient on hospital day 2.
Identify deliriogenic medications in a 5-medication regimen.

skills.name: PHI leakage check
skills.description: Scan arbitrary clinical text for PHI entities and produce a redaction map. Does not require FHIR patient context.
examples: Scan this discharge summary for PHI.
Does this note contain any protected information?

extensions.description: A2A v1 FHIR-context extension. The platform delivers FHIR credentials in `Message.metadata` keyed by this URI, with camelCase fields {fhirUrl, fhirToken, patientId, fhirRefreshToken?, fhirRefreshTokenUrl?}. TrustedRisk consumes the metadata in its before-model hook, populates the shared FHIRContext ContextVar, and never lets the credentials reach the LLM prompt. See https://docs.promptopinion.ai/fhir-context/a2a-fhir-context.html.

selfCritique.description: Every clinical recommendation passes through a 4-critic ensemble (clinical_safety + fairness + evidence + llm_judge) that may downgrade confidence, force abstain, or request a replay before the response is emitted. The LLM critic has a deterministic floor (pass-through approval) so it never blocks unilaterally.

memoryLayer.description: Prior DecisionCards for the same patient are retrieved from a SQLite-backed memory store. When a valid (non-expired, same-model-version) card is found, it can serve directly; otherwise a fresh tool chain runs and detect_recommendation_drift flags any meaningful change vs the prior.

temporalValidity.description: Every RiskEstimate carries a valid_until timestamp scaled by clinical-risk severity (high LACE → 4h, moderate → 12h, low → 24h). Expired cards force a re-call.

fairnessAuditCalibration.description: Subgroup-multiplier baseline is calibrated on the receiving cohort (internal calibration workflow output) and falls back to literature defaults (HRRP/HCUP/JAMA) when the calibrated artifact is absent.

counterfactualExplanation.description: Per-factor what-if sweep shows how each LACE component contributes to the predicted risk and identifies a minimum-modification path that would flip the recommendation tier.

multiTenant.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant (RFC 6749 §4.4) with per-client allowed_fhir_servers allowlist enforces tenant isolation: a token issued for tenant A cannot be used to query tenant B's FHIR endpoint.

auditTrail.description: Append-only HIPAA-style audit log (PHI-redacted SHA-256 hashing) plus an RFC 6962 Merkle audit chain for tamper-evidence; reproducibility archive enables byte-identical replay of any historical decision.

rightToExplanation.description: GDPR Art. 22 / EU AI Act Art. 13 right-to-explanation surface — every DecisionCard is paired with a patient-friendly audit summary on demand.

differentialPrivacyEquity.description: Equity dashboard publishes subgroup intervention / abstain / risk rates with Laplace-mechanism differential privacy.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: Optional bearer-token authentication (RFC 6749 §4.4). Disabled by default; enable via TRUSTEDRISK_OAUTH_ENABLED=1.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Static API-key authentication for marketplace-mediated A2A calls. Configured via TRUSTEDRISK_API_KEYS env var (comma-separated). When set, every A2A call must carry `X-API-Key` matching one of the configured values.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
